diagnosis.cause: `manage.py` exists at the repo root with a valid shebang (`#!/usr/bin/env python`, line 1) but is not marked executable in the repository, so `./manage.py` fails with exit code 126 on Linux.

doc.text: Replace `./manage.py load_initial_data` with `python manage.py load_initial_data` (and likewise `./manage.py runserver` → `python manage.py runserver`) so the command works regardless of whether the executable bit is set.

fix.log:
$ chmod +x manage.py

step command → python manage.py load_initial_data
